printBody: Prepare the sheet to hang at home and the compact rescue sheet.
printLead: Prepare the sheet to hang at home and the compact rescue sheet.
printUnavailable: Only someone who can edit the home prepares the sheets and sees the last reading.
printRevokeWarning: Sheets already hanging up will stop opening.
printCodeMissing: Prepare the codes before printing this sheet.

publicRescueLead: Rescue sheet for the people who respond.

publicMissing: This code does not match a home.

extraLead: Family recipes, weekly meal plan, pantry, shopping lists by store and aisle, the family double-entry ledger, the reading log of the public codes, and, on Premium, the change register.
extraRecipesLead: Write recipes by hand, or import structured data from a public page when available.
extraRecipesReadOnly: You can read the recipes, but your role cannot change them.
extraRecipeNeedServings: The number of servings is not valid.
extraRecipeImportLead: If the public page exposes structured recipe data, DomuSafe reads it without downloading images. Private addresses stay blocked.
extraShoppingLead: Organise shopping by store and aisle. Check items off while you shop.
extraPantryLead: Keep stock and expiry dates by hand. The barcode is optional; where the device allows it, you can read it with the camera without downloading extra libraries.
extraPantryReadOnly: You can read the pantry, but your role cannot change it.
extraPantryNeedMinQuantity: The minimum stock is not valid.
extraPantryScanHint: Frame the barcode. Reading uses only the tool already on the device.
extraPantryScanUnsupported: This device cannot read barcodes with the camera. You can type them by hand.
extraPantryScanFailed: The camera did not open. Check permissions or type the code by hand.
extraMealLead: Organise breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack. Link a recipe or write a title by hand, then print or save as a document.
extraMealReadOnly: You can read the meal plan, but your role cannot change it.
extraMealPrintLead: Document generated by DomuSafe. Use the browser print dialog to save as a document.
extraMealNeedTitle: Write a title or choose a recipe.
extraMealNeedServings: The number of servings is not valid.
extraFinanceLead: Accounts, double-entry movements, budgets, savings pots, recurring entries, expense splits and balances. Manual entry only.
extraFinanceLocked: The family ledger is included from the Basic plan upwards. On the Free plan you can read this explanation, but not the accounts.
extraFinanceReadOnly: You can read the ledger, but your role cannot change it.
extraFinanceSplitNeedResidents: At least two people in the home are needed to split an expense.
extraFinanceReportEmpty: No balances in the chosen period.
extraFinanceNeedPostings: Choose two accounts and two non-zero signed amounts.
extraFinanceNeedBudget: Choose an account, a start date and a positive amount.
extraFinanceNeedGoal: Write a name, choose an account and a positive target.
extraFinanceNeedRecurring: Write a description and the next date.
extraFinanceNeedSplit: Choose a movement, two people and two positive shares.
readingsLead: Each opening of a public code of this home appears here, newest first. Only the time, the kind of code and, when the browser sends one, a short device label are kept.
readingsLocked: The reading log is included in the Premium plan, including the thirty-day trial. On the Free, Basic and Advanced plans you can read this explanation, but not the list.
readingsHidden: Only someone who can edit the home sees the reading log.
guideFamilyBody: Each account can create one or more families. The first home is created with the family. If you belong to several families, open them from Family or from the switcher at the top.
guideHouseBody: The switcher at the top changes home and stays on the same section. In Home you fill in the guest manual, the water, gas, power and boiler cutoffs, the tradespeople, the utilities and the boiler-check deadline.
guideThemeBody: In Account choose light, dark or automatic. Automatic follows the device. Before sign-in the choice stays only on this device.
guideRestBody: The dashboard groups deadlines into overdue, this week and this month. The dashboard and Personal open the full-screen rescue view, with the cutoffs and the call to medical help. On Premium, or during the thirty-day trial, the same screen opens rescue message drafts on the phone, including a practice mode, without sending them from the server. Family opens the full-screen tablet view: contacts you can call with one tap, house cutoffs, next deadlines and lifesaving medicines, with large touch targets. Personal holds rescue cards, services and, on the Premium plan, tax tasks. Vault keeps the encrypted documents. Print and code prepares the sheets to hang at home. In Extra you find recipes, the weekly meal plan, the pantry, shopping lists by store and aisle and, on the Premium plan or during the thirty-day trial, the reading log of the public codes.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Reload the page.
auditLead: History of family actions, without sensitive contents.
auditLocked: The change register is included in the Premium plan, including the thirty-day trial.
auditHidden: Only family administrators can see the change register.
casaLead: Manual of the open home: what a guest needs, and where water, gas, power and the boiler are shut off.
casaPreviewLead: This is the guest view. Cutoffs and tradespeople stay hidden.
casaGuestHint: What you write here is visible to anyone with the guest view.
casaPhoneHint: With the international prefix, for example +39.
casaReadOnly: You can read these details, not change them.
casaPhoneInvalid: Write the number with the international prefix.

casaInventoryEmpty: There are no rooms yet. Add the first room by hand.
casaInventoryNoStorage: No closet or container in this room.
casaInventoryLooseItem: In the room, without a container

vaultUnexpected: The operation could not be completed. Try again.

successionLead: Activities for the whole family. Fill them in by hand, without a step-by-step guide.
successionLocked: The succession checklist and the inheritance kit are included in Premium, including the thirty-day trial. With the current plan you can read this explanation, but you cannot edit the activities or print them.

successionFamilyBody: Activities to keep ready, and an inheritance kit to print. Premium and the thirty-day trial can edit and print them.
guideSuccessionBody: The family holds the succession checklist: papers, will, notary, property titles, the declaration within twelve months and utility transfers. With Premium, or during the trial, you mark them by hand and print the inheritance kit. The sheet does not contain the vault documents.

hostMarkPlan: Premium and the thirty-day trial can change it.
hostMarkFree: Free and Basic keep the DomuSafe mark on printed sheets.
hostMarkAdvanced: Advanced shows no DomuSafe mark and has no mark of its own.
hostWelcomeLong: The welcome sentence is too long.
hostLogoHint: A very small picture. A large one is not saved.
hostLogoTooBig: The picture is too large. Choose a smaller one.
hostTwoFactor: If you sign in with a password, saving requires the two-step check.
guideHostBody: In Account, an administrator on Premium or during the thirty-day trial can choose a name, a colour, a welcome sentence and a small logo. They appear on the sheets and on the public pages. Free and Basic keep the DomuSafe mark on the sheets. Advanced shows neither that mark nor a mark of its own.
